events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commits on origin, AUDIT rows, logs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -1; for c in 3fff8f22 c38ce69 6e7b2b6 9799d599 1670dddf; do echo "$c $(git branch -r --contains $c 2>/dev/null | grep -c origin/main)"; done; git show --stat 3fff8f22 | head -12; grep -nE '^\| G1(29|46) ' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-400; grep -n 'T-240' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3 | cut -c1-200; ls /tmp/t240/ /tmp/t240-probe.log /tmp/t240-negative.log 2>&1 | head -12

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show 3fff8f22 -- app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | sed -n '/^@@/,$p' | cut -c1-400; sed -n 145p /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | grep -oE 'c38ce69|6e7b2b6|3fff8f22' ; grep -cE 'FAIL' /tmp/t240-probe.log; tail -3 /tmp/t240-probe.log | cut -c1-200; cat /tmp/t240-negative.log | head -10 | cut -c1-200; git diff --stat HEAD -- app/scripts/probe-details.mjs; lsof -ti:4361 | head -2

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n 'SHOT_TEXT\b' app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | head -5 | cut -c1-250; grep -n 'guideMedians' app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | cut -c1-300; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:4361/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/; ls -d /tmp/t240* /tmp/*t240*export* 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/probe-details.mjs | grep -nE 'BASE|argv|usage' | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check export recipe and new commits since
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; head -5 /tmp/t240-export.log | cut -c1-200; tail -3 /tmp/t240-export.log | cut -c1-200; git diff --stat 30ea25fc HEAD | tail -8; ps -o pid,command -p $(netstat -anv -p tcp 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /\.4361$/ && $6=="LISTEN"{print $9}' | head -1) 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find which server serves port 4361
events.input: $ ls /tmp/t240-wt 2>&1 | head -3; ps -ax -o pid,command | grep -E '4361' | grep -v grep | cut -c1-250 | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the served directory of the :4361 server
events.input: $ lsof_cwd=$(ps -o pid= -p 37240 >/dev/null && /usr/sbin/lsof -a -p 37240 -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | grep ^n | cut -c2-); echo "cwd=$lsof_cwd"; ls "$lsof_cwd" 2>/dev/null | head; cat "$lsof_cwd/serve.py" 2>/dev/null | head -20

events.text: Checking the staged mirror at :4361. Next I'll build a fresh export of HEAD on my own port and run the probe against it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read export script usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls app/scripts/export-static.sh scripts/export-static.sh 2>/dev/null; f=$(ls app/scripts/export-static.sh scripts/export-static.sh 2>/dev/null|head -1); sed -n 1,25p $f | grep -E '^#|OUT|DEST|\$1|\$2' | head -15 | cut -c1-200; stat -f '%Sm' /tmp/srv4361/tantra-workshop-live

events.name: Bash
events.head: Build clean static export of HEAD in a worktree
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; rm -rf /tmp/t240v-wt; git worktree add -q --detach /tmp/t240v-wt HEAD && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules /tmp/t240v-wt/app/node_modules && cd /tmp/t240v-wt/app && (bash scripts/export-static.sh /tantra-workshop-live http://127.0.0.1:4371/tantra-workshop-live > /tmp/t240v-export.log 2>/tmp/t240v-export.err; echo rc=$? >> /tmp/t240v-export.log)

events.input: $ sleep 1; until grep -q '^rc=' /tmp/t240v-export.log 2>/dev/null; do sleep 15; done; tail -2 /tmp/t240v-export.log | cut -c1-200
